note: Hand-drafted by the build agent from the saved live snapshot to exercise the watcher pipeline with a replay model. Not output of a live model run (no API key was available on 2026-11-01).

changes.title: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini snapshots shut down on 2027-01-14; replace with gpt-6-luna

source.quote: On October 14, 2026, we notified developers using certain GPT-4 series models of their deprecation and removal from the API on January 14, 2027.

changes.title: gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.1 and gpt-5.4-nano shut down on 2027-04-01; replace with gpt-6-sol or gpt-6-luna

source.quote: The following models are deprecated and will be removed from the API on April 1, 2027, with six months' notice. Migrate to the recommended replacements before the shutdown date.

changes.title: whisper-1 and gpt-4o transcription models, plus /v1/audio/translations, shut down on 2027-02-26; replace with gpt-live-transcribe or gpt-transcribe

source.quote: On August 26, 2026, we notified developers using `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize` of their deprecation and removal from the API on February 26, 2027.

changes.title: Older GPT-5 and o3 snapshots shut down on 2026-12-11; replace with gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra or gpt-5.6-luna

source.quote: On June 11, 2026, we notified developers using older GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API on December 11, 2026.

changes.title: The /v1/prompts API and reusable prompt objects shut down on 2026-11-30; move prompt content into application code

source.quote: The `v1/prompts` API and reusable prompt objects are scheduled to shut down.

changes.title: The Assistants API has shut down; migrate to the Responses API and Conversations API

source.quote: The Assistants API shut down on August 26, 2026. Migrate to the Responses API and Conversations API using the [migration guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/assistants/migration).

changes.title: openai (npm) 7.44.0 makes Live Decision item events unions, a breaking type change in a minor release

source.quote: `DecisionItemCreatedEvent.item` and `DecisionItemCreateEvent.item` are unions, so callers that directly access `item.content` or `item.role` may no longer compile.

changes.title: openai (pypi) 3.37.0: Decisions question instructions can be a string or a list of parts, a breaking type change in a minor release

source.quote: In Live response models, question `instructions` can now be a string or a list of structured text, image, or JSON parts; check `isinstance(question.instructions, str)` before using string operations and handle the structured form.
